study type: Retrospective case series identified from a retrospective review
exposure: Bacterial contamination of IVF embryo culture
Removal of the zona pellucida from contaminated blastocysts
cohort: Patients undergoing IVF/ICSI treatment whose embryo cultures were affected by bacterial contamination.
finding: Removing the zona pellucida from bacterially contaminated frozen blastocysts resulted in successful clinical pregnancies and live births.
